sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Extracellular surface display confirmed by anti-FLAG mAb M2 detection of the N-terminal cleavage fragment; ADAM13-mediated ectodomain shedding was observed, indicating the tagged full-length protein is correctly trafficked and membrane-anchored. Cadherin-specific adhesion function of pcdh8l was NOT MEASURED in this assay.
sites.rationale: pcdh8l is a PCDH8 paralog sharing the same single-pass type-I topology with a cleavable signal peptide followed by six extracellular cadherin repeats; the FLAG tag placed 'just before EC1' maps to the mature N-terminus, which for PCDH8 falls after signal peptide cleavage at residue 29 (S), making insert_after_residue=29 the only extracellular N-terminal junction. Python confirmed residue 29 = S and residue 30 = K, consistent with the topology landmarks. The site is 721 residues from the TM boundary (751), well beyond the ≥3-residue minimum. Position is topology_derived because the paper names a domain boundary ('before EC1') rather than a specific residue number in PCDH8 canonical numbering. Full-length FLAG-tagged pcdh8l (a PCDH8 paralog/related protein) co-transfected with ADAM13 in HEK293T cells; FLAG inserted 'just before the first cadherin repeat (EC1)', i.e. at the extracellular N-terminus of the membrane-anchored protein; extracellular accessibility confirmed by mAb M2 detection of the shed ectodomain fragment.

sources.claim: A Flag tag (DYKDDDDK) was introduced just before the first cadherin repeat (EC1).

literature_notes: All three ledger clips (L1, L2, L3) derive from the same paper (PMC5601995) and describe a single experimental construct: N-terminal FLAG-tagged pcdh8l. L2 is the most position-informative ('just before EC1') and was chosen as the primary supporting clip; L1 and L3 corroborate surface expression and extracellular accessibility. The evidence is indirect because pcdh8l is a Xenopus paralog, not human PCDH8 itself, so position_evidence is topology_derived rather than validated. No ledger line supports any internal loop insertion or C-terminal tag for PCDH8 or a close ortholog; no other sites are proposed.
